features.label: Saint-Domingue (France)
features.source: The richest colony in the Caribbean, lost to the Haitian Revolution.

features.label: Santo Domingo (France)
features.source: Ceded by Spain at Basel and retaken by Spain after the Napoleonic wars reached the island.

features.label: Louisiana (France)
features.source: Retroceded by Spain at San Ildefonso and sold to the United States three years later.
